test_title: PYST 4: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word pair in which the two given words are related to each other in the same way as the two words of the given pair are related to each other.

(The words should be considered as meaningful words, and they should not be related to each other on the basis of number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

Argentina : Peso
solution:
Logic : Country : Currency

__
 
• Peso is the currency of Argentina.

Similarly,

 
• Yen is the currency of Japan.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Japan : Yen"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information\__**

 
• 
 
**Nepal : Kyat**

 
 
• The currency of Nepal is the Nepalese Rupee (NPR), not the Kyat. The Kyat is the currency of Myanmar (Burma).
 
 
 
• 
 
**Russia : Baht**

 
 
• The currency of Russia is the Ruble (RUB), not the Baht. The Baht is the currency of Thailand.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Bangladesh : Schilling**

 
 
• The currency of Bangladesh is the Taka (BDT), not the Schilling. The Schilling was formerly used in Austria and is still used in some East African nations (like Kenya, Tanzania, etc.).
